title: Electrical Sensor-Network Fee Decision Table, Workmanship Warranties
content:
Under the Workmanship Warranties, an electrical sensor-network fee is added to the electrical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. The electrical sensor-network fee follows the calibration order opened under ADAS Sensor Calibrations for the customer-pay repair the coverage was issued on: a calibration completed with a dealer sublet invoice above zero, the dealer-sublet network fee; a calibration completed with no dealer sublet invoice, the in-house network fee; no calibration order for that repair, or one not completed, no electrical sensor-network fee.

| Calibration order for the source customer-pay repair | Status | Dealer sublet invoice | Electrical sensor-network fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| exists | completed | above zero | dealer-sublet network fee, USD 44.95 |
| exists | completed | none (zero) | in-house network fee, USD 29.95 |
| exists | not completed | any | none |
| none for that repair | none | none | none |

## Points of judgement

- **Which order.** The ADAS Sensor Calibrations order opened for the customer-pay repair the coverage was issued on; calibration orders opened for other work are not read.
- **Completion first.** Only a completed calibration order carries a fee; an open or otherwise unfinished order carries none, whatever its dealer sublet invoice.
- **Dealer sublet.** A completed order whose dealer sublet invoice is above zero takes USD 44.95; one completed in house, with no dealer sublet invoice, takes USD 29.95.

## Hypothetical cases

1. The source repair's calibration order was completed with a dealer sublet invoice of USD 310.00: USD 44.95 is added.
2. It was completed with no dealer sublet invoice: USD 29.95 is added.
3. The coverage was issued on an insurance claim repair, so there is no customer-pay repair and no calibration order for it: nothing is added.
